# `^BR` – GS1 DataBar Bar Code

[Overview](../README.md) · [Libraries](../libraries/README.md) · [Commands](README.md) · [Features](../features/README.md) · [Evidence legend](../METHODOLOGY.md) · [Compare images](../../benchmarks/accuracy/comparisons/README.md)


Print a GS1 DataBar (formerly Reduced Space Symbology) barcode for space-constrained identification.

Reference parameters: **a, b, c, d, e, f**. These describe the reference grammar, not a promise that any library honors every parameter. [Zebra guide, page 135](../../zpl-zbi2-pg-en.pdf).
